package kz.iitu.springlab.lifecycle;
2+
3+
import jakarta.annotation.*;
4+
import org.slf4j.*;
5+
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
6+
7+
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
8+
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
9+
import java.util.*;
10+
11+
@Component
12+
public class LifecycleDemo {
13+
14+
private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(LifecycleDemo.class);
15+
16+
private final DateTimeFormatter formatter;
17+
private final List<String> events = new ArrayList<>();
18+
19+
public LifecycleDemo(DateTimeFormatter formatter) {
20+
this.formatter = formatter;
21+
record("1. Constructor called");
22+
}
23+
24+
@PostConstruct
25+
void init() { record("2. @PostConstruct executed"); }
26+
27+
@PreDestroy
28+
void shutdown() { record("3. @PreDestroy executed"); }
29+
30+
public List<String> events() { return List.copyOf(events); }
31+
32+
private void record(String stage) {
33+
String line = LocalDateTime.now().format(formatter) + " " + stage;
34+
events.add(line);
35+
log.info("LIFECYCLE >> {}", line);
36+
}
37+
}

package kz.iitu.springlab.notify;
2+
3+
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier;
4+
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
5+
6+
import java.util.*;
7+
8+
@Service
9+
public class NotificationService {
10+
11+
private final Notifier primary; // @Primary -> EmailNotifier
12+
private final Notifier console; // явно указан через @Qualifier
13+
private final List<Notifier> all; // все бины, отсортированные по @Order
14+
private final Map<String, Notifier> byName; // ключ — имя бина
15+
16+
public NotificationService(Notifier primary,
17+
@Qualifier("console") Notifier console,
18+
List<Notifier> all,
19+
Map<String, Notifier> byName) {
20+
this.primary = primary;
21+
this.console = console;
22+
this.all = all;
23+
this.byName = byName;
24+
}
25+
26+
public String viaPrimary(String message) { return primary.send(message); }
27+
28+
public String viaConsole(String message) { return console.send(message); }
29+
30+
public List<String> viaAll(String message) {
31+
return all.stream().map(n -> n.send(message)).toList();
32+
}
33+
34+
public Set<String> names() { return byName.keySet(); }
35+
}
